BiblicalUsage: The word names the jackal, the wild creature of the waste places. Lamentations says even the sea monsters draw out the breast to nurse their young, while the daughters of Jerusalem have become cruel, and Malachi says God laid Esau's mountains waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the jackal's tenderness in Lamentations shames a people who had stopped caring for their own children.
